snippet.title: Rosaluna: Moonlit Vengeance (Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description: Set in the Northern Highlands of a mystical, reimagined Vietnam shrouded in eternal snow, the game follows the young girl Rosie, and her shapeshifting Celestial rabbit companion - Pearly - on a grueling quest to bring justice to her beloved grandma.
